role: typed monitor PTY sessions, latch completion, classify stale/dead, and launch the typed completion handler. agent-functions.sh only forwards the separate manual-monitor command and has no chain-monitor ownership.

completion_latch.rule: OR latch explicit terminal marker or declared emits event
completion_latch.terminal_marker: AGENT_COMPLETE on its own stripped terminal line
completion_latch.event_match: compiled typed lifecycle find requires one strict unprocessed expected-emits event with exact nonempty run_id and guarded agent/session ownership

stale_behavior.detector: md5 of last 20 captured lines unchanged
stale_behavior.max_stale: typed MONITOR_DEFAULTS max stale count, overridden by the typed CLI arguments
stale_behavior.effect: advisor nudge, blocked diagnostic, or failure classification
stale_behavior.nudge_budget: durable ceiling MENTIKO_MONITOR_MAX_NUDGES tracked in ${session}_nudges; survives screen-echo stale resets and monitor restarts; an exhausted budget escalates instead of nudging forever (20ce3b1)
stale_behavior.never: stale output does not imply completion

death_behavior.local: pgrep child process under pane pid
death_behavior.remote: skip local process death checks for ssh/docker

launches.completion: web/lib/runner-v2/completion-launch.ts starts the typed entrypoint in a separate PTY when chain.json exists
launches.typed_bridge: completion is unconditionally typed; missing chain context, exit 64, malformed launch context, PTY rejection, or missing child acceptance fails closed without a shell fallback
launches.completion_env: the launcher persists an allowlisted run context to a private one-shot 0600 file, passes only its random path in PTY argv, and requires deletion-after-validation as child acceptance before the monitor returns
launches.chainless: a monitor without chain.json fails closed and leaves completion active and unacknowledged

invariants: dead without declared event is not success
completion matcher never accepts monitor diagnostic events
event match respects agent id and run id
completion handler runs outside monitor pty
screen-echo repaints never grant more nudges: the nudge budget is durable (20ce3b1)
no shell monitor, completion latch, lifecycle mutation, or diagnostic API remains in agent-functions.sh
agent_session_checklist: typed bootstrap or typed routed launch creates the agent session with an explicit run context
the typed monitor receives only allowlisted run context and observes the same namespaced PTY daemon
completion accepts only authoritative evidence; stale output or a dead process without a declared event is not success
actionable blocked runs retain their owned PTY; terminal cleanup removes monitor then agent and verifies both removals
missing typed monitor, completion, context validation, or PTY acceptance fails closed without a shell monitor or launcher
